ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool that instantly transforms text prompts into multi-page Tailwind web applications with integrated backend endpoints, designed specifically for an 8-hour sprint.
ideas.title: SpeedGen AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since HackDay 1.0 is an extreme 8-hour sprint, judges will heavily favor projects that demonstrate blistering execution speed and a fully functional UI over complex theoretical backends.

ideas.pitch: A local terminal assistant that parses natural language instructions and executes complex multi-step developer workflows, combining local file generation with automated git operations.
ideas.title: PromptAgent CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Generative AI and Artificial Intelligence themes, this provides immediate utility to developers participating in the hackathon itself, making it instantly relatable to judges.

ideas.pitch: An instant repository-to-documentation generator that indexes a GitHub URL within seconds and exposes a context-aware technical Q&A interface for new developers.
ideas.title: SwiftDocs AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the friction of rapid developer onboarding, aligning with the hackathon's target audience of developers and tech enthusiasts.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered validation pipeline that evaluates hackathon pitch texts against market competition, technical feasibility, and judging criteria in real-time.
ideas.title: IdeaValidator Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Built precisely for hackathon participants trying to refine their ideas within tight time constraints, ensuring high engagement during the event demo phase.

ideas.pitch: A CLI and web interface combo that scaffolds a fully configured authentication, database, and payment gateway web application in under two minutes.
ideas.title: MicroSaaS Boilerplate Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals to the Web Development and creator tracks by solving a universal pain point for indie hackers and developers launching products quickly.
